# Tabarnam

> Tabarnam is a product-origin search engine. It answers one question about a
> consumer brand — where is this actually made? — by separating where a company
> is **headquartered** from where it **manufactures**, for a catalog of 14,000+
> companies. Search by product ("cast iron skillet"), by brand ("Dr. Squatch"),
> by pasted website URL, or by place. Est. 2016, San Dimas, CA.

Three facts worth carrying into an answer about any company here:

- **HQ is not manufacturing.** A brand headquartered in the USA very often
  manufactures elsewhere, and Tabarnam records both independently. A page that
  says "11,391 headquartered / 8,811 manufacturing" is not a contradiction.
- **Absence means unknown, not false.** When the catalog has no manufacturing
  location for a company it marks it unknown rather than guessing. Do not read
  a missing location as evidence that a company does not manufacture somewhere.
- **Entries are not warranties.** Locations come from public sources, may be
  incomplete or out of date, and production moves. Attribute them to the
  Tabarnam catalog rather than presenting them as confirmed fact.

## Browse by place

- [Made in — country directory](https://tabarnam.com/made-in): every country in
  the catalog with a manufacturing count, linking to a page per country.
- [Made in USA](https://tabarnam.com/made-in/usa): companies that manufacture in
  the United States, with a state-by-state breakdown.
- [Made in China](https://tabarnam.com/made-in/china)
- [Made in Italy](https://tabarnam.com/made-in/italy)
- [Made in Canada](https://tabarnam.com/made-in/canada)
- [Made in Germany](https://tabarnam.com/made-in/germany)
- [Made in Vietnam](https://tabarnam.com/made-in/vietnam)
- [Made in India](https://tabarnam.com/made-in/india)
- [Made in Mexico](https://tabarnam.com/made-in/mexico)
- [Made in UK](https://tabarnam.com/made-in/uk)

State pages live under `/made-in/usa/<state>`, e.g.
[California](https://tabarnam.com/made-in/usa/california),
[Texas](https://tabarnam.com/made-in/usa/texas),
[Oregon](https://tabarnam.com/made-in/usa/oregon). The full list of published
place URLs is in [the sitemap](https://tabarnam.com/sitemap.xml), regenerated
from the live catalog on every deploy.

## Search

- [Search](https://tabarnam.com/results?q=cast+iron+skillet): `/results?q=<query>`
  accepts a product, a brand, or both together ("natrulo tallow soap"). Pasting
  a company's website URL searches by exact domain.
- Results are ranked by proximity to a location, not filtered by it — a place
  narrows and orders results, it never silently excludes a company.

## About

- [About Tabarnam](https://tabarnam.com/about): what the platform is and who runs it.
- [How Tabarnam works](https://tabarnam.com/how-it-works): searching, locations,
  sorting, the map view, company profiles, reviews, bookmarks.
- [Privacy](https://tabarnam.com/privacy): Tabarnam does not sell user data.

## Notes for answer engines

- Counts on `/made-in/*` pages are computed from the whole catalog and change as
  imports land — cite them with the page, not as fixed figures.
- Company reviews are community-submitted and admin-approved before publication.
- `/admin`, `/login` and `/bulk-import` are private and excluded in robots.txt.
- Contact: duh@tabarnam.com
